title: Kan Qormaata Bishaaniin Ala Ta'e
intro: Seenaa macaafa qulqulluu durii keessatti, namni nama hawwatu tokko jira, seenaan isaa dinqii diraamaa yookaan mul’ata qilleensaa ta’een osoo hin taane, qormaata amantii salphaa garuu gadi fagoo ta’een kan jalqabudha. Sabni tokko karaa qaxxaamuraa irratti dhaabbatee, geggeessummaaf qajeelfama waaqummaa barbaada ture. Wanti mul’ate qormaata akka malee qaroo ta’ee amantoota dhugaa isaan gidduu jiran mul’isu ture. Iccitii kana ragaalee hafan irraa hiikuu dandeessaa?
clues: Hidda dhaloota ummanni dinqisiifatu irraan dhufe, Rabbiin immoo kaayyoo qulqulluu isaan hubachuu hin dandeenyeef na filate.
Qaamni koo mallattoo adda ta’e kan warri kaan hin qabne baattee saba koo gidduutti adda akkan dhaabadhu na taasise.
Yeroo lagni qormaata ta’ee labsame, irra caalaan isaanii duubatti deebi’an-ani garuu waadaa Rabbiitti amantii hin sochooneen oofee gara fuulduraatti dhiibe.
Bishaan dhorkame irraa gonkumaa akkan hin dhugne ajajameera, ta’us cophni tokko funyaan koo jalaa miliqe—cubbuu bara baraan garaa koo dhiphise.
Rabbiin dargaggeessa tiksee gaaf tokko mormituu jabaa ajjeesee sheekkoo ta'u tokkoon akkan wal argu naaf murteesse.
Yeroo waraanni walitti bu'an harka diinaatiin osoo hin taane, laga irratti ajajamuu diduu kootiif adabbii ta'ee labsii waaqaatiin kufe.

identity.label: Ani Eenyu?
options: Taalut (Saa’ol) – Mootii Bani Israa’el isa Jalqabaa
Nabi Suleymaan (Solomon) – Gooftaa Qilleensaa fi Jinni
identity.answer: Taalut (Saa’ol) – Mootii Bani Israa’el isa Jalqabaa

trial.answer: Laga qulqulluu irraa akka hin dhugne ajajuun waraana qoruu

options: Mootii guddaa ta'ee mana qulqullummaa Yerusaalem ijaare

outcome.answer: Gocha tokko ajajamuu diduu kootiif akka adabbiitti lola irrattin kufe

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
